intro.title: Modern comprehensive manufacturer of lubricating oils and greases
intro.p1: Cerotd (Shandong) Lubrication Technology Co., Ltd. is a modern, comprehensive and professional manufacturer of lubricating oils and greases, integrating R&D, production, sales, service, technical training and logistics distribution, and boasts a considerable industry scale and influence in the domestic market.
intro.p2: The company is located in Jining City, Shandong Province, known as the Hometown of Confucius and Mencius, the Land of Propriety and Righteousness. Rooted in Jibei Ershilipu New Material Industrial Park, it stands as a vibrant and promising rising star with strong growth momentum in the park. Our factory is equipped with advanced fully automatic blending production lines, and has established a strict and comprehensive quality management system.
intro.p3: We have long been deeply engaged in the R&D and innovation of automotive lubricants. With solid professional technical strength, we deliver high-tech, specialized and comprehensive lubricant production solutions to fully meet the lubrication needs of various types of equipment.

antifreeze-g11-green.summary: Green ethylene glycol multi-effect engine coolant (antifreeze).
antifreeze-g11-green.description: Ethylene glycol (EG) based. IAT / HOAT corrosion inhibitor technology. Standard bright green, clear and transparent, with no suspended solids or stratification. Suitable for cooling systems of older cast-iron engine cars, light trucks, construction machinery, agricultural machinery, 2-stroke / 4-stroke motor boats and generator sets. Packaging: 1kg / 4kg / 5kg / 9kg / 10kg / 20kg / 200kg.
